title: Laser Squad
build: Blade Software's 48K tape (TOSEC: Laser Squad (1988)(Blade)[scenario 1-2].tzx and [scenario 3-5].tzx): a BASIC loader, the loading screen, the 22,521-byte engine at $5E28-$B620 and five headerless scenario blocks of 18,911 bytes each, loaded at $B621-$FFFF

credits.role: game design and Spectrum program (manual; Spectrum Computing)
Spectrum tape and joystick routines, crunching (manual)
in-game graphics and loading screen (Spectrum Computing; signed on the loading screen)

tools.emulator: release ZEsarUX-13.0, ZEsarUX_linux-13.0-ubuntu24_x86_64.tar.gz, run as a Spectrum 48K; check-emulator 47 of 50 on 3 November 2026 (count-while-running, load-keeps-frame-phase and warp, each with a workaround in kit/skills/spectrum/tool-zesarux)
tools.host: Linux x86_64 (Ubuntu 24.04, no display), a hosted cloud session

accuracy.note: the port was written first, routine by routine in lockstep with the game, and the listing's comments on code were written from it, so it found none of them wrong

80 of the 7,482 comments: 20 of the 5,551 made from the game's tables, none wrong, and 60 of the 1,931 written by hand, 10 wrong (9 in a detail, and one dictionary word read as letters where it holds colour codes and an arrow); all 10 were corrected, with the same mistakes in other comments and in facts.md

manual.title: Laser Squad Players Manual (PDF), Spectrum Computing
